_about: Crop-verified OCR readings for this book (audit trail + replay). The 2019 reprint is vertical-RTL Traditional; tesseract chi_tra_vert --psm 5 OCRs it at only ~85% char accuracy, too error-dense for targeted-fix replay to reconstruct a clean source. For B01 the data/zh source was therefore produced by full-page EYE-TRANSCRIPTION against magnified scans (the whole reference batch was read for the voice gate). The entries below are the readings CROP-VERIFIED at magnification (load-bearing number, proper names, systematic mangles) recorded per CLAUDE.md so the audit trail survives; page is the PDF page the crop was read on. See PROGRESS.md.
